layout_provenance.method:
Single source for the walk-mode rebuild (build_twobed_v4.py), #18 plan_overlay and
#21 accessible_area. Every coordinate is MEASURED on interior/twobed/apt02_fp.png
(268x351 px) in plan-pixel index space (pixel centre = integer, x right, y down),
read from 6-8x zoomed gridded crops and the ink mask (luminance < 80) plus
OpenCV contour/Hough output (cv2.findContours on the 3x3-opened ink for the thick
walls, cv2.HoughLinesP on thin ink for 1-2 px partitions). Nothing was copied from
build_twobed_v4.py (v4 outline is off by up to 16 px, e.g. right wall x=262 vs ink 254-259).
tests/pascal/layout_pascal.json (rejected #20) was used ONLY as a cross-check of
the entrance (x 99-129) and bathroom door (y 268-298) ink breaks.
layout_provenance.scale: metres_per_px = sqrt(63 m2 / 71278.9 px2) = 0.029730 (area 63 m2 by construction; plan has no printed dimensions)
layout_provenance.secondary_reference: tests/pascal/layout_pascal.json (#20, rejected) used only to cross-check entrance and bath door ink breaks

area_note: Area uses layout['metres_per_px'] (sqrt(63 m2 sourced total / internal-face floor polygon px2): 63 m2 BY CONSTRUCTION, not an independent measurement). Outline 71278.9 px² × (0.029730 m/px)² = 63.000 m².
iou_headline: raw iou_buffered_4px (gate); furniture-masked score is in diagnostics.furniture_masked

furniture_masked.note: secondary score: plan furniture symbols masked (see FURNITURE_SYMBOLS / ROOM_ERODE_PX in plan_overlay.py). NOT the gate; raw iou_buffered_4px is the headline.
